claims: Paul Thomas Anderson directed One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won six awards in total.
One Battle After Another won Best Adapted Screenplay.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was held in Los Angeles on March 15, 2026.
One Battle After Another (Warner Bros.) won Best Picture.
Paul Thomas Anderson (Writer/Director) is a key winner for One Battle After Another.
Sara Murphy (Producer) is a key winner for One Battle After Another.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet.
One Battle After Another defeated Sinners, Frankenstein, Bugonia, and F1, among others.
The New York Times reported One Battle After Another's sweep.
